## Dials versus screens {background-image="images/threeWiseMonkeys/640.jpg" background-opacity="0.05"}

Sebastian my 11-year-old, told me he preferred EVs that just have a big screen. As opposed to my preference for physical dials, like in the Hyundai Ioniq

With the dials, you can feel your way until you grasp them without having to take your eyes off the road.
